arxiv-2109-03457.title: Uncertainty Quantification and Experimental Design for Large-Scale Linear Inverse Problems under Gaussian Process Priors Thanks:
arxiv-2109-03457.creator: Cédric Travelletti, David Ginsbourger, Niklas Linde
arxiv-2109-03457.description: Abstract We consider the use of Gaussian process (GP) priors for solving inverse problems in a Bayesian framework. As is well known, the computational complexity of GPs scales cubically in the number of datapoints. We here show that in the context of inverse problems involving integral operators, one faces additional difficulties that hinder inversion on large grids.

arxiv-2208-11878.title: Vulnerability Analysis of Time Synchronization in Automotive Ethernet
arxiv-2208-11878.creator: Rishikesh Kakade ∗1 , Joey Chou ∗2 , Shannon Torcato ∗3
arxiv-2208-11878.description: Abstract The operation of many network communication protocols require accurate time synchronization between nodes. In the automotive space, IEEE 802.3bw (commonly referred to as automotive ethernet) is quickly becoming the most popular in-vehicle communication protocol between electronic control units (ECUs).

arxiv-2511-15141.title: ItemRAG: Item-Based Retrieval-Augmented Generation for LLM-Based Recommendation Conference: ; ; CCS: Information systems Recommender systems
arxiv-2511-15141.creator: Sunwoo Kim, Geon Lee, Kyungho Kim, Jaemin Yoo, Kijung Shin
arxiv-2511-15141.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sunwoo Kim, Geon Lee, Kyungho Kim, Jaemin Yoo, Kijung Shin. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have been widely used as recommender systems, owing to their strong reasoning capability and their effectiveness in handling cold-start items. To better adapt LLMs for recommendation, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has been incorporated. Most existing RAG methods are user-based, retrieving purchase patterns of users similar to the target user and providing them to the LLM.

arxiv-2512-15348.title: Extended defects in hard disk system and melting criteria.
arxiv-2512-15348.creator: M. V. Kondrin, Y.B. Lebed, V. V. Brazhkin
arxiv-2512-15348.description: Abstract The hard sphere model is widely used in description of fluids and solid media as a zero approximation to real systems. Despite the uniqueness of the model, few analytical results are known for it, both for the 2D and 3D cases.

britannica-1911-falerio.description: Article 'Falerio' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 10), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. It was probably founded as a colony by Augustus after his victory at Actium.

pmc-10712317.creator: Fang Ni, Faheem Afzal Shah, Jie Ren
pmc-10712317.description: SUPPRESSOR OF MAX2 LIKE 1 (SMAX1) is a member of the SUPPRESSOR of MAX2 1‑LIKE family of genes and is known as a target protein of KARRIKIN INSENSITIVE2 (KAI2)-MORE AXILLARY BRANCHES2 (MAX2), which mediates karrikin signaling in Arabidopsis. SMAX1 plays a significant role in seed germination, hypocotyl elongation, and root hair development in Arabidopsis.
